notes.title: Post Release Update #1
notes.content: [p]Small Update adding some Quality of Life features: [/p][list][*][p]Added the ability to right click cards in a lot of cases during combat to view them in detail (this also works for enemy cards when holding ALT and hovering over them)[/p][/*][*][p]Restored ability to click on the star level of a card during many detail views to cycle through their star levels. This also applies to the new detail view mentioned above[/p][/*][*][p]Bug Fixes: [/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the round display would always display that it is the enemy's round (purely visual)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Added the ability to right click cards in a lot of cases during combat to view them in detail (this also works for enemy cards when holding ALT and hovering over them)
Restored ability to click on the star level of a card during many detail views to cycle through their star levels. This also applies to the new detail view mentioned above

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where the round display would always display that it is the enemy's round (purely visual)

notes.title: Fields of Malice Demo Update#1
notes.content: [p]Bug Fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where team size would not immediately update when upgrading a unit and therefore prevent you from summoning more in certain cases[/p][/*][/list]

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where team size would not immediately update when upgrading a unit and therefore prevent you from summoning more in certain cases
